title: fix(multiaxis): Rotary Parallel cuts the full turn of the bar
body:
## Cause (measured)

Rotary Parallel ran the 3-axis swarf raster one time, in a frame that lays the rotary axis down with local z up. That raster finishes the bar from above only. Two stages lose the bottom of the bar:

1. The ring ladder stops at Bottom, read as a tip height in the laid frame. With Bottom at -R, the last ring has its ball centre 30 degrees under the horizontal.
2. With a lower Bottom, the rings stop 45 degrees under the horizontal. `build_sups` turns each facet normal to the sky, so the bottom quadrant counts as shallow (raster) ground. The raster takes the top tangent and never reaches that ground. The rings skip loops that touch only shallow facets.

A third fault hid the band: the rotary path dropped the raster and ring notes on the default path.

## Measured arc

Laid bar R 3 mm, 1 mm ball, Bottom -R (`crates/motion/tests/rotary_coverage.rs`):

| Case | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| stepover 0.8 | 126 deg uncut, 210..336 deg (270 = bottom); 4 empty 30-degree sectors | 0 empty sectors; widest gap 12.1 deg |
| stepover 0.25 | 126 deg uncut, the same arc | 0 empty sectors; widest gap 8.1 deg |

With Bottom at -R-2r (stage 2 only), the uncut arc was 94.6 deg. The example part (Journal, Bottom 9.525 mm under the axis) is held by stage 2: about 90 deg, a quarter of the turn. The issue said 10-20 %.

## What changed

- `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary.rs`: Rotary Parallel plans the bar in two halves. Half A is the laid frame. Half B is the same frame turned half a turn about the axis.
- New `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary/halves.rs`:
  - Each half keeps the cut over its own upper half.
  - Half B goes back into A's frame by the rigid half turn.
  - The seam: A keeps centres down to half a ball radius under the axis plane. B keeps only centres strictly under A's lowest kept centre, on each side, read over the turned surface. No pass is cut twice. The seam step is one ring step (6.4 deg on the fixture).
  - Half B is held to Bottom where the radially posed ball touches the bar. A Bottom above the axis thus keeps the cut to the upper arc, as before.
  - The lifts of half B become links, so the radial relink rebuilds them along the radius.
- Review rework (head `864897476`): no cut of the single-frame path is lost on a part that is not round, and no place is cut twice:
  - A cut of half A under the seam stays where no kept cut of half B stands at the same place (a ball centre within half a pass spacing). Example: the lower wall of a keyway, which half B cannot see.
  - A cut of half B over the seam is added where half A cuts nothing at the same place (a wall that faces down).
  - The pass spacing is the stepover, or the scallop step `sqrt(8 r tol)`, the larger.
  - New `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary/gaps.rs`: the ball-centre cover (a grid hash) and a reach reading on a fixed grid of at most 48 stations x 72 angles. A ray from the axis finds the outermost surface. A place under Bottom, or a corner where no ball fits, is skipped. A place with no ball centre within one pass spacing gets the note `Rotary Parallel: no pass reaches the surface over <a0>..<a1> deg about the axis (from the top of the laid bar toward its +y side) at stations <s0>..<s1> mm along it - that surface stays uncut`. Only a path with no such place has the full-turn note.
  - Round bars keep their output: `rotary_coverage` and the example program are byte-identical to the first head.
  - If half B fails with an error other than `Empty`, the whole operation is refused (also where the single-frame path posts). The refusal is visible. This is recorded in the decision file.
- All base notes (raster, rings) now reach the path. A path that cuts under the axis has the note `Rotary Parallel: the passes go all the way round the bar - the machine must turn the part on a rotary axis through the whole turn; set Bottom above the axis to cut only the upper arc`.
- No change to `build_sups` or to any shared finishing helper. The planning time of Rotary Parallel is about two times the old time.

A ball sphere that is clear of the model stays clear under a rigid rotation. The radial pose keeps every ball centre. So each half is as safe as the old single run. The new moves go through the existing held-end clip, picked-face clip, radial relink (no rapid through the part) and radial pose.

## Goldens that moved

Only the two Rotary Parallel programs that had the band moved. The review rework moved neither of them again.

**`crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach/wrap_rotary_parallel_microarc4.nc`** (the microARC test part, Bottom -R): regenerated with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-app --test microarc_test_part`. Lines 3246 -> 2684, G1 2924 -> 2191, G0 226 -> 415; diff +1333 / -1895. The feed moves that turn A, binned in 30-degree A sectors: before `187 154 122 108 436 319 328 472 97 116 148 186`, after `187 154 122 116 148 186 187 154 122 116 148 186`. The two halves now give the same cut in each half turn. The first head did not run this binary.

**The example:** It was regenerated with the test's own tool (`WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-app --test continuous_4axis_part`). No hand edits.

| `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.nc` | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Lines | 3125 | 2866 |
| G1 lines | 1662 | 1508 |
| G0 lines | 1398 | 1300 |
| Mid-journal feed endpoints in each 30-degree A sector | 31 30 3 5 11 0 0 9 5 3 16 30 | 31 30 3 3 16 30 31 30 3 3 16 30 |

- Diff: `.nc` +1426 / -1685 lines, `.camproj` +8531 / -12275 lines.
- The program has fewer lines: the deep rings of the old single frame (under the equator) go, and half B cuts the bottom with raster lines.
- The start and the end are as before: the same header, the same T1 change, the first `G53 G0 Z0` then `G0 A44.604`, the same first passes, then `G94`, a G0 retract, `M9`, `M5`, `G53 G0 Z0`, `M30`.
- The guide page `first-continuous-4axis-part.md`, its two toolpath pictures (made again by `site/tools/first_continuous_4axis_pictures.py`) and its pins in `site/tests/test_first_continuous_4axis_part.py` follow the new program: the line count, the excerpts, the A range -85.708..265.687, the last A, the A180 line and the second note.
- No non-rotary golden moved. `golden_cl`, `example_catalog*`, `first_part_programs` and the finish3d suites are green with no change. No shipped example or catalog case uses Rotary Parallel on a machine with limited rotary travel.

## Maintainer decision (owner's standing word 2026-11-22: choose recommended while he sleeps)

1. The example is regenerated with the test's own tool. Dropped: hand edits.
2. `operations::rotary_parallel_generates_radial_axes_and_verifies_clean`:
   - Old assert (main): every cut tip, read as a vertical ball in the laid frame, is not under Bottom (`lowest >= -4`).
   - First head: `a >= -4 || b >= -4`. The review found this vacuous, because `b` holds for each move under the axis.
   - New assert (review rework): over the axis plane only half A cuts, and each feed and plunge there keeps A's own law (`low >= -4`). Under the axis plane each one keeps B's law in B's frame. Every feed and plunge of either half touches at or over the Bottom in world z (`tip z >= -4.1`, a real bound). Both halves cut more than 20 moves. Each 30-degree sector holds a pass. The "last line IS the Bottom" assert stays.
   - Dropped: the old one-frame law, because it pinned the band.
3. Limited rotary travel (`tilthead.mch`, B -120..120): a full-turn path is refused by the machine check. The check names the move, the axis, the angle and the travel, and nothing posts. The way to the reachable arc is a Bottom above the axis: the existing tilt-head fixture (Bottom 1) posts clean with no change. New pin: `a_full_turn_rotary_parallel_refuses_on_a_head_that_cannot_reach_under`. The clean post on a 4-axis A machine is `continuous_4axis_part` (microARC 4). Dropped: clipping the cut to the machine's reach in the generator, because the generator does not know the machine. Follow-up: #3649 (a parameter for the angular range).

The decision file is `docs/decisions/2970-rotary-parallel-halves.md`. Also dropped: the `build_sups` change of the earlier plan, because it changes every 3D pattern and makes the split depend on the mesh winding.

## Pins

- `crates/motion/tests/rotary_coverage.rs`:
  - `the_rotary_parallel_goes_all_the_way_round_a_laid_bar`
  - `the_rotary_parallel_goes_all_the_way_round_at_a_fine_stepover`
  - These two tests check the empty sectors, the seam step against the flank, no pass cut twice, no move emitted twice, and the full-turn note. Both are red on main.
  - `the_rotary_parallel_keeps_the_ladder_notes` (a `rings:` note reaches the path)
  - `a_bottom_over_the_axis_keeps_the_cut_to_the_upper_arc`
- `crates/app/tests/operations.rs`: `rotary_parallel_generates_radial_axes_and_verifies_clean` (sector coverage added; verifies clean with stock)
- `crates/app/tests/rotary_verify.rs`: `a_full_turn_rotary_parallel_refuses_on_a_head_that_cannot_reach_under`
- `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary/single_frame_tests.rs` (review rework; in `--lib`). The reference is the generator before the halves (laid swarf, radial relink, radial pose), kept for tests only:
  - `a_keyway_loses_no_cut_of_the_single_frame_path`: keyed bar R 10, keyway walls at z = +-5, 6 mm ball. Before the rework, 52 centre samples that the single frame cuts were lost (stations 23.7..36.3 mm, 347 deg: the lower keyway wall). After the rework, 0 are lost.
  - `a_keyway_is_cut_once_in_each_place`: no two passes that are not neighbours stand within 0.1 mm.
  - `the_reach_reading_names_the_arc_no_pass_reaches`: the arc and stations are named. No note for a full turn, and no note for a Bottom over the axis.
- `crates/app/tests/rotary_parallel_keyway.rs` (new): the keyed bar in bar stock. The only blocking finding is the keyway corner rest that a 6 mm ball cannot reach (envelope gouge 0.020 mm, rest 1.95 mm). The single-frame path reports the same finding (gouge 0.020, rest 1.99). Both halves cut. Each rapid ends on the clearance cylinder. The full-turn note is there.
- Not covered: an eccentric section (a round collar off the axis). The axis fit refuses every variant that was tried ("every axis fits this model equally"), so no such part reaches Rotary Parallel. The decision file records this gap in the evidence.

## Gate (final head `864897476`, after `git merge origin/main`, debug, by name)

- motion: `--lib` (570), `--no-run`, `rotary_coverage`, `rotary`, `rotary_offset`, `rotary_links`, `rotary_adaptive`, `rotary_contour_x`, `rotary_dflat`, `swarf_pose_continuity`, `swarf_reentry`, `multiaxis`, `multiaxis_rough`, `refusal_ghost_frames`: all green. The first head also ran `finish3d`, `finish3d_gaplink`, `finish3d_holes`, `finish3d_land`, `finish3d_overhang_and_chord` and `scallop_ceiling` green. The rework does not touch their code.
- app: `--lib` (300), `rotary_parallel_keyway`, `continuous_4axis_part`, `first_4axis_part`, `first_part_programs`, `rotary_verify`, `first_traverse_rotary`, `first_traverse_rotary_mill_turn`, `mcp_rotary_stack`, `opening_rotary_pose`, `rotary_contour_x`, `rotary_face_selection`, `rotary_feed_cap`, `rotary_field_parity`, `rotary_fixtures`, `rotary_letter`, `rotary_subplate`, `rotary_subplate_standing`, `wire_4axis`, `first_traverse_posed`, `center_cut_multiaxis`, `coarse_laws`, `microarc_test_part` (after its golden was regenerated), `probe_op`, `project_roundtrip`, `setup_align_multiaxis`, `operations`, `golden_cl`, `conformance`, `posting`, `verify`, `mcp`, `docs_troubleshooting`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`: all green.
- clippy `-D warnings`: motion `--all-targets`, app `--lib --test operations --test rotary_parallel_keyway --test rotary_verify`: clean.
- site: `PYTHONUTF8=1 python -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_first_continuous_4axis_part.py`: OK.

## Not run

- No heavy lane (P3). No light lane.
- No app window. No machine or simulator run.
- Not tested: an eccentric section (the axis fit refuses it). The reach reading reads only the outermost surface along each radial. A wall hidden behind other material along the radial is not read.

Changelog: Rotary Parallel now cuts the full turn of a bar when Bottom is at its underside (before, about a quarter of the turn at the bottom stayed uncut with no warning); a Bottom above the axis keeps the cut to the upper arc, and the path notes say when the passes go all the way round.

Effort: high (no escalation)

Fixes #2970
